name: Halkhata
what: A Bangla Android app for small grocery shop owners to run sales, customer credit (baki), stock and daily accounts entirely on their own phone.
hard_part: No server at all: the whole ledger lives in SQLite on the phone, with every screen derived from one ledger module covered by golden tests. Data safety comes from two layers instead of a cloud: Android Auto Backup of the database plus a one-tap JSON backup shared to Drive or WhatsApp that restores on a new phone.
status: Signed APK on public download page · not on Play yet
demo_note: Download the APK from the page; no account or password, first open asks for the shop name
facts: Works fully offline, no account, no server
47 Flutter tests in the phone-only build
